description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Oil Seal Housing Gasket & Seal Set.
Includes the Oil Seal Housing Gasket and Rear Crank Shaft Oil Seal.
It even includes New Bolts!
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Seal Housing Gasket
Qty 1 – Rear Crank Shaft Oil Seal
Qty 5 – Oil Seal Housing Bolts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
